manifest.name: dsh-session-handoff
manifest.description: Hand your long DSH session over to a fresh one: /handoff summarizes the recent conversation with an LLM, creates a clean new session in the same workspace, injects the summary as its first message, and auto-opens it. The origin session is unchanged.

bundle.text:
# dsh bundle patch: 在 profile 的空条目列表上插入一行插件。
# name 必须是包名（模块说明符），运行时经 profile fallback 解析。
- insert:
    - id: handoff
      name: dsh-session-handoff

readme.text:
[](LICENSE)
[](package.json)

English | [中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**Context window filling up? One `/handoff` condenses dozens of turns into a one-page handoff document and continues in a clean new session — the old session stays untouched.**

Long DSH sessions get slow, eat the context window, and start forgetting. DSH ships compaction and fork, but
nothing that says *remember what matters, then start fresh*. This plugin is that missing step.

When the context window or session size crosses your threshold it **asks first**. On confirm, it writes a
handoff document — **goal / approach / done / files / next steps / open questions** — creates a new session in
the same workspace, injects the document as its first message, and opens it. The new session already knows the
job; you don't re-explain anything.

readme.section: How it differs from compaction and fork
readme.text:
| | `/compact` | fork | this plugin |
|---|---|---|---|
| Origin session | compacted in place | kept | **kept as-is**, linked back from its title |
| Load on the new session | same session | **full history copied** | **one page of handoff notes** |
| Who continues | yourself | yourself | **a fresh session with a clean context** |
| When it switches | automatically at the threshold | manually | **asks first at the threshold**, or fully automatic |

readme.section: How it differs from compaction and fork
readme.text:
Compaction repacks the old baggage, fork copies it. This plugin writes the baggage down as a one-page brief
and travels light.

- **Manual** — `/handoff [<N>|all]`; no argument uses the configured `turns` (default 50 user messages)
- **Automatic** — three policies: *replace* (before native compaction) / *hybrid* (when the session gets heavy) /
  *native* (never switch automatically)
- **Asks first** — confirm popup by default; `notify` / `auto` modes available. After you dismiss a suggestion,
  the trigger level must grow by another 50% before asking again
- **Health row** — a persistent "context xx% | session xxMB | ~N turns left" line above the composer
- **Clean handoff** — new session inherits workspace, model route and agent preset (system prompt / tools / skills),
  with none of the old context
- **Structured document** — persisted to disk as well; browse past handoffs from the settings panel
- **Auto-open** — the client half waits for the child session and navigates to it (once per child, no re-jumps on replay)
- **Decision log** — every decision (action + reason) is recorded and viewable in settings
- **Zero core changes** — a single `dsh.bundle.patch` row; only public host services are used

Requires DSH desktop or CLI with Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`.

Tested on: `0.1.0-rc.5`–`rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`.

The plugin is a standard DSH bundle: put it into the `node_modules` of **the profile you are using**, then
register it there. Example for the desktop profile:

```sh

readme.section: 1) put the repository anywhere (or unpack dsh-session-handoff-0.3.1.tgz from the release)
readme.text: git clone https://github.com/MountBatten718/dsh-session-handoff.git ~/dsh-session-handoff

readme.section: 2) link it into the desktop profile's node_modules
2) link it into the desktop profile's node_modules
readme.text:
> The `desktop` profile is owned exclusively by the Electron app, so the CLI refuses `plugin add` /
> `--dump-config` for that name; point a differently-named symlink at the same directory for a read-only check.
> For a regular CLI profile, install this directory the same way you install other local plugins.

Type in any conversation's input box:

```text
/handoff          # use the configured turns (default 50 user messages)
/handoff 20       # summarize the last 20 user turns
/handoff all      # summarize every user message
```

What happens: the command card shows "summarizing…" → the LLM produces the handoff document →
the new session **auto-opens**; the origin session stays intact and is linked back.

> ⚠️ **Privacy**: the recent conversation text (user + assistant messages in the requested window) is sent
> to the configured model to produce the summary.

Most options live in **DSH → Settings → Plugins → session handoff** (applied immediately). Full profile patch:

```yaml
- id: handoff
  name: dsh-session-handoff
  config:
    autoMode: hybrid            # replace / hybrid (default) / native

Without `provider`/`model`, the current session's latest logged model route is used.

- **Host half** (`index.mjs` + `lib/*.mjs`, plain ESM): public services only — `commands` (`/handoff`),
  `llm`, `agents` (`ctx.agents.create` — session **and** agent together, inheriting the origin's cwd /
  model route / agent preset via `agentPresets.mount`), `workspaceRegistry.attachSession`,
  `sessionTitle.rename`, `userQuestions`. Automatic handoff hooks `agent/pre-step` (step boundary = safe point).
  The client half reads health, edits config and triggers manual handoffs over Typert RPC.
- **Client half** (`src/client/` → `scripts/build-client.mjs` → `lib/client.js`): health row, settings panel
  and handoff card; a `handoff` conversation node auto-opens the child session.
- **Black box**: every handoff writes stages and outcomes to
  `<DSH_HOME>/session-handoff-docs/handoff-trace.jsonl` (long text redacted, rotates at 5 MiB).

`lib/client.js` is committed; after editing `src/client/**`, rebuild it:

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs           # rebuild lib/client.js
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check   # verify the artifact matches the sources byte-for-byte
```

The build script uses only Node's built-in TypeScript type stripping — no dependencies to install.

- Supports DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` through `rc.8`, `0.1.1-rc.2`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, and `0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2`
  (verified on 0.2.1-rc.2 on 2026-10-20: plugin load, health row, settings panel and stats RPC all work).
  DSH `0.1.2-alpha.1` split the conversation UI/service and needs a separate client-side migration.
- `session.snapshotEvents()` is marked `@deprecated` by the host (it still uses it internally); a future
  kernel may need a different read entry point.
- Chain state (which handoff in the chain, "already handed off") is **in-memory only**; after a restart it is
  recovered from the marker on the old session's title, so the chain index degrades to 1 (display only).
- A failed automatic handoff is **not retried automatically**; use the manual "hand off" button instead.
- Auto-open relies on client-side polling; verify edge timing on your DSH version.

Based on [WeiYe6/dsh-session-handoff](https://github.com/WeiYe6/dsh-session-handoff) (MIT), which provides the
original `/handoff` command and handoff-document implementation. This fork adds automatic handoff, the health
row, the settings panel, document persistence, decision logging and subagent drain waiting.

[English](README.md) | 中文

**聊到上下文快满了？一条 `/handoff`，把几十轮对话压成一页交接文档，开个干净的新会话接着干——旧会话一字不动。**

DSH 的会话越聊越长：加载变慢、上下文吃紧、模型开始忘事。官方有"压缩"和"分叉"，但没有
"把该记的记住，然后换一个干净会话继续"。这个插件补的就是这一步。

它会在上下文或会话体积到点时**先问你一句**；你确认后，它把 **用户需求 / 方案梗概 / 已完成 /
涉及文件与产物 / 接下来做什么** 整理成交接文档，在同一工作区开一个新会话、把文档作为第一条消息注入，
并自动打开。你回来时，新会话已经知道要做什么，不用从头解释。

readme.section: 和"压缩"、"分叉"有什么不一样
readme.text:
| | `/compact` 压缩 | fork 分叉 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 旧会话 | 原会话被压缩 | 原会话保留 | **原会话原样保留**，标题留回链 |
| 新会话的负担 | 还是同一个会话 | **复制全量历史** | **只有一页交接文档** |
| 谁来接着干 | 还是自己 | 还是自己 | **全新会话 + 干净上下文** |
| 什么时候换 | 到阈值自动压 | 手动 | **到点先问你**，也可全自动 |

一句话：压缩是"把旧包袱打包"，分叉是"把旧包袱复制一份"，这个插件是"把旧包袱写成一页交接单，轻装出发"。

- **手动**——`/handoff [<N>|all]`，想切就切；不填轮数就用配置里的 `turns`（默认 50 轮用户消息）
- **自动**——按策略到点触发，三档模式：**替代**（抢在原生压缩前切）/ **混合**（会话过重时切）/ **原生**（不自动切）
- **先问你**——默认弹窗确认，可改成「只提醒」或「全自动」；点过「先不接力」后，触发量**再涨 50%** 才会重问
- **健康度行**——输入框上方常驻「上下文 xx% ｜ 会话 xxMB ｜ 还能撑约 N 轮」，点开看明细，心里有数
- **干净的接力**——新会话继承原会话的工作区、模型路由与 agent preset（系统提示 / 工具 / 技能），不带旧上下文
- **结构化交接文档**——并在磁盘留一份，设置页可翻历次记录、直接打开目录
- **自动打开**——客户端等新会话就绪后自动跳过去（每个子会话只跳一次，历史回放不会反复跳）
- **决策留痕**——每次判定都记一条决策日志（选了哪个动作、为什么），出问题能复盘
- **新会话可预设**——新会话用哪个模型、多强推理、什么工作权限，三项都可选「跟随原会话」
- **零核心改动**——只插入一行 `dsh.bundle.patch`，全部走宿主公开服务

要求：DSH 桌面版或 CLI，Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`。

已在下列内核上实测可用：`0.1.0-rc.5`–`rc.8`、`0.1.1-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.2`。

插件是标准的 DSH bundle 包，核心只有两件事：放进**你正在用的 profile** 的 `node_modules`，
并在该 profile 里登记。以桌面版（`desktop` profile）为例：

```sh

readme.section: 1) 把仓库放到任意目录（或直接解压 Release 里的 dsh-session-handoff-0.3.1.tgz）
readme.text: git clone https://github.com/MountBatten718/dsh-session-handoff.git ~/dsh-session-handoff

readme.section: 2) 软链进 desktop profile 的 node_modules
readme.text:
ln -s ~/dsh-session-handoff ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-session-handoff
```

然后在 profile 的 `package.json` 里登记依赖：

```jsonc
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-handoff": "link:/Users/you/dsh-session-handoff"
  }
}
```

并把 `dsh-session-handoff` 加进该 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`。重启 DSH 后生效。

> 桌面版的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 独占，CLI 会拒绝对它执行 `plugin add` / `--dump-config`；
> 想只读验证组合结果，可以做一个**换个名字**的软链指向同一目录再 `--dump-config`。
> 如果你用的是普通 CLI profile，也可以按该 profile 的常规插件安装方式装入本目录。

在任意会话输入框敲：

```text
/handoff          # 用配置里的轮数（默认 50 轮用户消息）
/handoff 20       # 总结最近 20 轮
/handoff all      # 总结全部用户消息
```

执行后：命令卡片显示"正在总结…" → LLM 生成交接文档 → 新会话**自动打开**，原会话原样保留并回链。

> ⚠️ **隐私提示**：所选窗口内的对话文本（用户 + 助手消息）会发送给配置的模型用于生成摘要。

大多数选项在 **DSH 设置 → 插件 → 会话接力** 里就能改（即时生效）。profile patch 里可写的完整键：

```yaml
- id: handoff
  name: dsh-session-handoff
  config:
    # —— 自动接力 ——

未配 `provider` / `model` 时，自动使用当前会话最近一次请求的模型路由。

- **宿主侧**（`index.mjs` + `lib/*.mjs`，纯 ESM）：只消费宿主公开服务——`commands`（/handoff）、`llm`、
  `agents`（会话与 agent 一起建，经 `agentPresets.mount` 继承 cwd / 模型路由 / preset）、
  `workspaceRegistry.attachSession`、`sessionTitle.rename`、`userQuestions`（原生问答弹窗）。
  自动接力挂 `agent/pre-step` 瀑布（步骤边界 = 安全点）；客户端经 Typert RPC 读健康度、改配置、手工换会话。
- **客户端侧**（`src/client/` → `scripts/build-client.mjs` → `lib/client.js`）：健康度行 + 设置面板 +
  会话接力卡片；命中成功事件后自动打开子会话（轮询等待可寻址，localStorage 去重）。
- **黑匣子**：每次接力把阶段与结果写进 `<DSH_HOME>/session-handoff-docs/handoff-trace.jsonl`，
  长文本脱敏成 `[omitted N chars]`，文件超 5 MiB 自动轮转。

客户端半区产物 `lib/client.js` 已随仓库提供；改了 `src/client/**` 之后需要重建：

```sh
node scripts/build-client.mjs           # 重建 lib/client.js
node scripts/build-client.mjs --check   # 校验产物与源码逐字节一致
```

构建脚本只依赖 Node 内建的 TypeScript 类型剥离，不需要安装任何依赖。

- 支持 DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` 至 `rc.8`、`0.1.1-rc.2`、`0.2.0-rc.2`，以及 `0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2`
  （2026-10-20 在 0.2.1-rc.2 上实测：插件加载、健康度行、设置页、统计接口均正常）；
  `0.1.2-alpha.1` 拆分了会话 UI / 服务，需要单独迁移客户端半区。
- `session.snapshotEvents()` 已被宿主标注 `@deprecated`（宿主内部仍在使用）；未来内核换入口时需要跟改。
- 链路状态（第几棒 / 已交接）只存内存：重启后靠旧会话标题上的标记恢复"已交接"，链序号会退化为 1（仅影响展示）。
- 自动接力失败后不会自动重试（避免重复创建会话），可在会话里手工「换会话」。
- 自动跳转依赖客户端轮询时序，真实浏览器下的极端时序仍需按你的 DSH 版本自测。

本项目基于 [WeiYe6/dsh-session-handoff](https://github.com/WeiYe6/dsh-session-handoff)（MIT）扩展而来。
上游提供了 `/handoff` 命令与交接文档的基础实现；本仓库在此基础上增加了自动接力、健康度行、设置面板、
交接文档落盘、决策日志与子代理收尾等待等能力。
